mapper.select: SELECT flow_code, enterprise_name, uscc_code, user_name, phone_number, org_account_id, user_account_id, enterprise_code, flow_status, start_time, completion_time, e_sign_flow_id, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_register_flow WHERE uscc_code = #{usccCode} AND flow_status > 0 AND delete_flag = false LIMIT 1

SELECT flow_code, enterprise_name, uscc_code, user_name, phone_number, org_account_id, user_account_id, enterprise_code, flow_status, start_time, completion_time, e_sign_flow_id, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_register_flow WHERE uscc_code = #{usccCode} AND flow_status = 0 AND phone_number = #{phoneNumber} AND delete_flag = false LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_register_flow(flow_code, enterprise_name, uscc_code, user_name, phone_number, enterprise_code, org_account_id, user_account_id, flow_status, start_time) VALUES (#{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.flowCode}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.enterpriseName}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.usccCode}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.userName}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.phoneNumber}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.enterpriseCode}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.orgAccountId}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.userAccountId}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.flowStatus}, #{enterpriseRegisterFlowModel.startTime})
mapper.select: SELECT flow_code, enterprise_name, uscc_code, user_name, phone_number, org_account_id, user_account_id, enterprise_code, flow_status, start_time, completion_time, e_sign_flow_id, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_register_flow WHERE flow_code = #{flowCode} AND delete_flag = false
mapper.update: UPDATE enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_register_flow SET flow_status = 2, enterprise_name = #{enterpriseName}, user_name = #{userName}, completion_time = now() WHERE delete_flag = false AND flow_status = 1 AND flow_code = #{flowCode}
UPDATE enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_register_flow SET flow_status = 1 WHERE delete_flag = false AND (flow_status = 0 OR flow_status = 1) AND flow_code = #{flowCode}
UPDATE enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_register_flow SET flow_status = 2, completion_time = now() WHERE delete_flag = false AND flow_status = 1 AND flow_code = #{flowCode}
